consequences.archiveEra: The S208-S209 archive (and the HIST previews drawn from it) sits at club levels ~9-10, not 15. HIST was therefore a different club-level regime from the calibration partition; it was never only a different tier bookkeeping.
consequences.thresholdsNotInLevelQualityUnits: If cost thresholds were fixed in quality units, at level 9 they would sit 4*5*6 = 120 displayed points above the level-15 values. Against Scott Ritchie PRV-0014/0015 (frozen amplitude, untiered) a +60 or +120 displayed shift raises RMSE from 18.2 to 50-77. The steep regime starts where it does at level 15: thresholds are not level-shifted quality constants. The earlier remark that the grey threshold 120.1 'equals quality 100' at offset 70 is a coincidence of that level, not a mechanism.
